long_biography.plain_text:
Tweddle Group executive Andrew Tweddle chose to sell its connected-vehicle platform to Nuance in 2013, while concentrating the remaining business on information services for vehicle owners and dealers. The sold platform had helped Toyota bring mobile applications and online services into its Entune system.

Outside business, he has served as president of the Tweddle Foundation, alongside Qing Yao Tweddle as secretary and treasurer. Its grants have supported Gulliver Preparatory School and Badjao Bridge, which helps children in the Philippines attend school and provides daily nutritious meals, tutoring and basic health care.
